title: Featured Artist on Dutch Art Box
content: I'm thefeatured artistthis week in Dutch Art Box, along with a short interview.Question: What inspires you to paint?Answer: Dinosaurs and parking lots. One is beyond our imagination, the other is beneath our notice.The website wasfounded by a mother / daughter teamin the Netherlands who wanted to feature emerging and established artists, and share tips about art supplies and methods. Anyone can sign up to be featured.
